assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 PNG, 16:9. Clean Value at Risk diagram: a smooth profit-loss distribution centered near zero, left side labeled loss direction, right side labeled profit direction, left alpha tail shaded in coral, a vertical cutoff at the alpha percentile, and a simple horizontal arrow labeled VaR from zero to the cutoff. Use exact short labels only: Loss, Profit, alpha tail, VaR. Academic vector-like style, off-white background, navy axes and curve, coral tail shading. Keep a 7% safe margin.

Academic vector-like finance style, no long explanatory text. Keep a 7% safe margin.
